text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the votes from her loyal and dedicated fans, Matikanefukukitaru is able to race in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wishing to return the favor however she can, she makes a declaration to her kind supporters…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rather than depending on luck, she vows to rely on her own strength instead.
